subject: PO fast-track: provisional burst and quality gate for launch
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@lumenplay.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumenplay.com
Date: 2026-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO fast-track request: provisional burst for launch

Hi Aditya,

Quick one — our product team is going live with the new recommendation model on 6/02 and we need a provisional burst window for the first 72 hours to avoid throttles. Ballpark need: add ~2M tokens/day for 3 days (spike pattern attached to email thread). Can Redwood fast-track this via a PO?

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm a temporary rate for the additional headroom and any launch credit you can extend?
- We need a quality gate: latency p95 under 150ms for the endpoint and no rate-limit induced 429s during the window. If there are performance exceptions we need immediate escalation.

Procurement will push a PO if we have a simple acceptance path. We can share our PO template (copied procurement).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Sr PM, LumenPlay

Attachments referenced: launch-spike-sample.csv (sent separately by engineering)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@lumenplay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO fast-track request: provisional burst for launch

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch. We can support a provisional short-window uplift. High level:

- Proposed provisional uplift: +2M tokens/day for 72 hours (6/02 00:00 UTC -> 6/05 00:00 UTC).
- Pricing: one-time uplift fee at our Launch Burst rate (USD 0.0008/token) with a 10% launch credit applied to the uplift portion if you commit the PO within 48 hours.
- True-up: usage beyond the provisional uplift will be billed at the standard overrun rate; we can amortize any customer credits against that invoice.
- Quality gate: we'll instrument a temporary SLA monitor on your token route and commit to an internal p95 latency target of <150ms during the window. If we see degradations we'll open an incident and auto-scale to Dedicated pool (if available) or failover to a compatible model with prior notice.

Laura / Ben — can you confirm the legal/billing acceptance path for a PO + 30 net and whether we need a signed SOW for a 72-hour uplift? I've attached a provisional quote for their PO team to reference.

Sarah — if that sounds ok I can route a brief acceptance email and the team will provision the headroom on our side once Procurement sends the PO and we have the acceptance of the billing terms.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisional-quote.pdf (one-page uplift pricing)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: procurement@lumenplay.com, Sarah Lin <sarah@lumenplay.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-29T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO fast-track request: provisional burst for launch

Hi Sarah / Procurement,

Quick note from ops: we can accept a standard PO referencing Deal DL-4729 with Net 30 payment terms. For a temporary 72-hour uplift we don't require a separate SOW; our standard SOW template is attached if Legal prefers it in the record.

Two operational items for Procurement to include on the PO:
- Line item: "Provisional launch burst (2M tokens/day) — 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-05"
- Billing contact and PO number (please include the PO PDF via email).

Once we receive the PO we will provision the uplift and send an invoice draft. If you need the invoice before provisioning we can provide an invoice-draft.pdf.

Laura Bennett
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-template.docx

From: Procurement <procurement@lumenplay.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com

Hi Laura,

Attached is PO_78932.pdf. We will use PO 78932 for the provisional burst line item described by Sarah. Please confirm:
- Will Redwood accept the PO as-is?
- Can you provide a proforma invoice referencing PO 78932?
- Confirmation that the temporary SLA (latency p95 <150ms) will be monitored and that Redwood will notify us immediately if there's a capacity exception.

We appreciate the fast turnaround — need provisioning by 6/01 close of business so engineering can run a sanity check prior to 6/02.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
LumenPlay

Attachment: PO_78932.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah@lumenplay.com>, procurement@lumenplay.com
Date: 2026-05-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO fast-track request: provisional burst for launch

Aditya / Laura — we can accept PO_78932 as long as the PO includes the two items Laura called out. Operational steps I'm putting in motion:

- Invoice: attaching invoice-draft.pdf (will update PO number and finalize once Procurement confirms).
- Credit/discount: we will apply a one-time 10% launch credit to the uplift line on the final invoice. The remaining uplift will be subject to normal true-up rules.
- Monitoring & escalation: I created a short runbook for the route and added a temporary monitoring hook tied to your status page. If p95 rises above 150ms or 429s exceed 0.5% we will auto-open incident RED-312 and notify your engineering and product teams.
- DocuSign: please sign here to accept the provisional uplift terms: https://docusign.com/link/XYZ-approve-burst

If Procurement confirms PO 78932 by EOD 5/30 we'll provision the headroom on 6/01 as requested.

Ben Carter
Launch & Pricing, Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice-draft.pdf
